annotations.title: FAR 6.302 / FAR 8.405-6 Sole-Source Justification & Approval (J&A / LSJ) Drafter

description: Draft a complete 12-Part FAR 6.303-2 Justification & Approval (J&A), FAR 8.405-6 Limited Sources Justification (LSJ), or FAR 16.505(b)(2) Fair Opportunity Exception package for Contracting Officers. Returns a strictly validated `SoleSourceJaResponse` JSON object containing `statutory_exception_overview`, `far_6_303_2_twelve_part_ja_sections`, `unacceptable_delay_and_duplicative_cost_quantification`, and `sam_gov_posting_and_approval_routing` grounded in FAR 6.302-1 (10 U.S.C. § 3204(a)(1) / 41 U.S.C. § 3304(a)(1)), FAR 6.303-2 (12 Mandatory Content Elements), & FAR 8.405-6 / 16.505(b)(2). This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive GovCon compliance and capture analysis call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key or X-SignalTender-Key; `sole_source_requirement_and_vendor_uniqueness_text` accepts 15 to 45,000 characters, while `statutory_authority_pathway` and `estimated_dollar_value_and_approval_tier` calibrate the regulatory regime and threshold assumptions). Use this tool when executing FAR 6.302 / FAR 8.405-6 Sole-Source Justification & Approval (J&A / LSJ) Drafter workflows; use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead for general FAR/DFARS clause flow-down audits, or `generate_compliance_matrix` for general Section L/M 'shall' requirement extraction.

estimated_dollar_value_and_approval_tier.default: $18.5M Total Estimated Value — Competition Advocate Approval Tier ($750K to $15M / $20M DoD PEO/HCA Threshold)
estimated_dollar_value_and_approval_tier.description: Operational context, threshold parameters, or compliance posture assumptions (defaults to '$18.5M Total Estimated Value — Competition Advocate Approval Tier ($750K to $15M / $20M DoD PEO/HCA Threshold)').

sole_source_requirement_and_vendor_uniqu.description: Primary solicitation text, clause excerpts, deliverable schedule, or technical/financial context for FAR 6.302 / FAR 8.405-6 Sole-Source Justification & Approval (J&A / LSJ) Drafter (15 to 45,000 characters).

statutory_authority_pathway.description: Target regulatory regime, statutory authority, or evaluation framework (defaults to 'FAR_6_302_1_Only_One_Responsible_Source_10_USC_3204_a_1').

name: generate_justification_ja_sole_source

far_6_303_2_twelve_part_ja_sections.description: Structured line-by-line regulatory audit, classification, or quantitative schedule rows.

sam_gov_posting_and_approval_routing.description: Statutory governance protocol and actionable submission verification checklist.

statutory_exception_overview.description: Executive determination overview, regulatory citations, and readiness score.

unacceptable_delay_and_duplicative_cost_.description: Paste-ready compliance narratives, control specifications, or submission sections.
